description: Suggest each goal's monthly amount: goals by nearest date (no kind of goal goes first), each taking what gets it there on its date until what Plan has for goals runs out (what they take now plus what is left after every bucket). A goal with no date is sized as a year of what is missing; a reached, target-less or paused goal gets nothing. The preview is the suggestion; `commit: true` writes it through the same rule a typed amount on Goals uses, so the rest of the split moves with it. **Dry-runs by default**; the document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

commit.description: Default false. False shows the suggestion; true writes it.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
